name: Howler Terror Incarnate
tactics: Terror incarnates fall on their enemies with shadow lope. The shock of an unexpected attack adds to the fear they cause. Terror incarnates are faithful servants, and one that has taken up with a dark master gladly gives up its life to protect that creature.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Terror Incarnate
traits.details: Any enemy that starts and ends its turn within the aura takes 10 psychic damage.

traits.name: Shadow Spines
traits.details: Whenever a creature adjacent to the terror incarnate misses it or its rider with a melee attack, that creature takes 15 necrotic damage.

auras.name: Terror Incarnate
auras.details: Any enemy that starts and ends its turn within the aura takes 10 psychic damage.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature that cannot see the terror incarnate and has not yet been dominated by it during this encounter

hit.description: The target is dominated and its at-will attacks deal 1d8 extra psychic damage and target Will (save ends; the target takes a -4 penalty to the saving throw; the effect ends if the target takes radiant damage). Until the effect ends, the howler is removed from play. When the effect ends, the howler appears in the unoccupied space nearest to the target.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: enemies in the blast that cannot see the terror incarnate

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target is dazed (save ends).

effect.description: The terror incarnate becomes invisible and can move its speed. It remains invisible until the end of its next turn.
